replace_criteria.benchmark_note: A ButtonUnmask press is complete only when the button cap visibly displaces relative to its stationary base. Container changes are separately recorded as target-binding evidence and never prove button completion.
success_conditions: The gripper reaches and contacts the intended button rather than merely approaching it.
The button cap visibly travels or becomes depressed relative to the stationary button base during the recent temporal sequence.
insufficient_evidence: Aligned approach, contact, downstroke, occlusion, or withdrawal without visible cap displacement.
A container appears, disappears, moves, or changes occlusion.
The final pose looks plausible but the recent sequence does not show cap travel relative to the base.

required_checks.question: Ignoring every container event, does the recent sequence show the gripper reaching and contacting the intended button?

Does the recent sequence directly show the button cap displacing or becoming depressed relative to the stationary button base? Contact, occlusion, downstroke, or withdrawal alone must be uncertain or no.

replace_criteria.unrelated_scene_policy: Container events may produce binding_updates but must not change either button-completion verdict.
